title: Serving The True Guru, Peace Is Obtained
summary: Ego is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
